messages.content: Southwest changed Monday's outbound, and the new flight lands after 9:00 p.m. I need to know what they will let me switch to without changing Thursday's Delta flight or the Cheshire reservation.

Because the schedule change exceeds two hours, Southwest will move only the affected outbound at no additional fare. Two Monday alternatives still have seats: WN 1862, ATL 8:35 a.m. to STL 9:20 a.m., or WN 2714, ATL 11:50 a.m. to STL 12:35 p.m. Both include your carry-on and checked supply case. Your separately ticketed Thursday Delta return and hotel would remain untouched.
Is there still an afternoon option on another airline, and what would it actually cost with the case?

Delta DL 1736 departs ATL at 2:10 p.m. and arrives STL at 2:55 p.m. The current one-way fare is $246, plus $35 for the checked supply case, for $281 total. Southwest would refund the affected outbound segment as a $214 travel credit, so switching carriers would require a new purchase rather than a free rebooking.
Compare the practical arrival times. I still need enough Monday to get settled before the 8:00 a.m. start Tuesday.

The 8:35 a.m. Southwest flight should put you at the Cheshire around 10:15-10:45 a.m.; the hotel can hold both bags until the room is ready. The 11:50 a.m. option should get you there around 1:45-2:15 p.m. Delta would likely reach the hotel around 4:00-4:30 p.m. All three preserve Monday preparation time, but the morning Southwest flight gives the largest buffer and costs nothing to change.
For this trip only, take the morning departure. The schedule disruption makes the extra setup time more important. Please replace just Monday's Southwest segment.
Understood. I will exchange only the disrupted Monday outbound for WN 1862 and retain the Thursday Delta return exactly as booked.
Go ahead, and confirm the bag terms and that neither the hotel nor Thursday flight moved.

The exchange is complete at no additional charge. New outbound: Southwest WN 1862, Monday, October 12, ATL 8:35 a.m. to STL 9:20 a.m., confirmation L8Q2RM. Your carry-on and checked supply case remain included. Delta DL 1284 on Thursday at 4:15 p.m. remains confirmed under H6T9VK, and the Cheshire reservation for October 12-15 remains unchanged under CHS-804621.
